name: agno
headline: Long-running Agent Harness: Multi-Context Workflow
short_description: The Long-running agent harness allows AI agents to efficiently work across multiple context windows with a structured approach. It's designed for developers and teams looking to manage incremental tasks and track progress across sessions effectively.
author: michael-f-bryan

sections.overview:
The Long-running agent harness is a skill designed for AI agents working across multiple context windows with structured task management. It enables developers to handle incremental tasks efficiently while tracking progress across multiple sessions. This harness provides a framework for managing extended workflows where context limitations require breaking work into manageable segments. Teams can install the skill using the skills CLI and optionally symlink it to their global agents folder for local development.
Plan and manage AI agent tasks incrementally.
Ensure each session has clear objectives and documentation.
Facilitate human check-ins at defined milestones.
sections.setup:
Terminal
Copy
`$ npx skills add https://github.com/michael-f-bryan/skills --skill long-running-agent-harness`
`git clone https://github.com/michael-f-bryan/skills`
sections.usage:
```
Act as a long-running agent harness for [TASK]. Break this into logical sub-tasks, execute them incrementally, and provide progress updates after each step. Maintain context across sessions and summarize findings in a structured report. Current state: [CURRENT_STATE]. Next action: [NEXT_ACTION].
```
